setup.title: Setup
setup.mock.note: No bridge is running, so the app shows recorded fixtures. Start it with pnpm dev.
picker.title: Choose a folder
picker.name: Name
platform.unavailable: The native dialog is not available yet. Use the browser build.
setup.game.title: Game and Steam
setup.game.first.title: Detection has not run yet
setup.game.first.hint: Press Detect again to look for RimWorld, Steam and your user data folder. Nothing is changed on disk.
setup.game.noinstall.hint: Choose the install folder below, or check that Steam knows the game.
setup.game.workshop.items.one: {n} item on disk, {total} listed by Steam
setup.game.workshop.items.other: {n} items on disk, {total} listed by Steam
setup.warning.steam.manifest-leftover: Steam left temporary copies of the game manifest next to the real one. They were ignored; they are harmless.
setup.warning.steam.userdir-version-mism: Your user data was last written by another game version than the installed one. Start the game once to refresh it.
setup.warning.steam.library-offline: A Steam library folder is not reachable, for example an unplugged drive.
setup.warning.steam.library-timeout: A Steam library folder did not answer in time and was skipped.
setup.warning.steam.install-update-pendi: Steam has an update waiting for RimWorld.
setup.warning.steam.install-needs-verify: Steam says the game files need verification.
setup.warning.steam.install-is-symlink: The install folder is a link to another folder.
setup.warning.steam.multiple-installs: More than one RimWorld install was found. The first one with the best confidence is used; override it below.
setup.warning.steam.proton-and-native-us: User data exists for both the native game and Proton. The newest is used.
setup.warning.steam.workshop-different-l: The workshop folder is in a different Steam library than the game.
setup.override.title: Overrides
setup.override.hint: Detection picks these by itself. Choose a folder only when it picked the wrong one. Clearing an override returns to detection.
setup.sources.title: Mod folders
setup.sources.hint: Folders RimStudio reads mods from, in scan order. Add as many of your own as you like. RimStudio only reads them.
setup.sources.empty.title: No mod folders yet
setup.sources.empty.hint: Run detection first, or add a folder of your own.
setup.source.drive: On drive {name}. If the drive is unplugged the folder shows as not reachable.
setup.add.title: Add a mod folder
setup.add.error: The folder could not be checked
setup.add.label: Label
setup.add.label.hint: Optional. The folder name is used when empty.
setup.probe.warn.no-mods-found: No mods were found in this folder.
setup.probe.warn.mods-found-deeper: Mods were found deeper than the suggested depth.
setup.probe.warn.ambiguous-layout: The layout is ambiguous: this could be one mod or a folder of mods.
setup.probe.warn.path-is-link: This path is a link to another folder.
setup.probe.warn.unreachable: Part of this folder could not be read.
setup.probe.overlap: This folder overlaps a folder already in the list, so the same mods would appear twice.
setup.probe.offline: The folder was not found or cannot be reached.
setup.remove.title: Remove this folder from the list
setup.remove.nofiles: No files are touched. The folder and its mods stay exactly where they are.
setup.scan.title: Library scan
setup.scan.hint: Reads the About files, load folders and definitions of every enabled folder. A scan reuses what has not changed; a full rescan reads everything again.
setup.scan.none: No scan has run in this session.
setup.scan.cancelled: The scan was cancelled; the result is partial.
setup.scan.diag.title: Diagnostics
setup.scan.diag.none: No problems found in the scanned mods.
setup.scan.diag.truncated: More problems exist than are listed.
setup.diag.about.no-supported-versions: The mod's About file lists no supported versions, so the game cannot tell which versions it is for.
setup.diag.about.field-dropped: An About field was ignored because it could not be read.
setup.diag.loadfolders.ignored-attribute: A LoadFolders entry uses an attribute the game does not read, so the condition has no effect.
setup.diag.scan.no-about: A folder looked like a mod but has no About file.
setup.diag.scan.dir-unreadable: A folder could not be read.
setup.diag.scan.def-file-broken: A definition file is not valid XML and was skipped.
setup.diag.scan.package-id-missing: A mod has no package id.
setup.ce.title: Combat Extended
setup.ce.hint: The Combat Extended patch generator needs Combat Extended in your library. The designer itself never needs it.
setup.ce.missing.hint: Subscribe to it on the Steam Workshop (package id {id}) and scan again. Vanilla design works without it.
setup.ce.unknown: Run detection to find the workshop folder, then Combat Extended is looked up there.
setup.settings.title: Settings
setup.settings.hint: A read only summary. The settings file is plain text; edit it by hand if you need to change something.
setup.settings.error: The settings could not be read
